title: EDG Community Update: Week of September 12th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**
- [Kucoin Exchange has distributed the rewards](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1569633118520512514) to Edgeware Trading Week campaign participants.
- New [Edgeverse AMA: ThinkRate](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1570355359352786945) featuring Ali Sajadpour (Recording for the same is now available in the [Community Calls' Directory](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/2966-community-calls-directory))
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v3.5.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.5.1) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade’s on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament)

## **Ecosystem Updates**
- The Cutting Edge Conquest round 5 aka the ‘[Discord Games](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1567120738221432833)’ has been concluded and so is the [series](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/5848-the-cutting-edge-conquest-a-community-campaigns-series-partially-postpaid).
- OnFinality added new functionality for Edgeware nodes: [Lightning Restore](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1570077429473103872)
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-sep-11/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nod
